# Full-playthrough input script for tests/playthrough/run.sh (#100), played with
#! seed 1
#! args --god --nerf
#! frames 20000
# from a launch folder with no sss_settings.ini. The outro returns to the title at
# about frame 15200; run.sh checks the milestones against expected.txt.
#
# Boot, as a fresh install sees it: OK the data notice (SPACE), type the callsign
# "ace7" and ENTER, then let the three lead-in cards play out (200 frames each).
0 0 SPACE
4 4 A
6 6 C
8 8 E
10 10 7
14 14 ENTER
#
# Frames 700-4059: FIRE held (fast-forwards the intro crawl) with a 10-frame gap every

# start the game from the title. P stops long before the outro returns to the title.
